reason: I'd download the free part and let my kid play with it, but I've never paid for an app and I'm not starting now. The kindergarten already teaches letters and numbers, and YouTube is free.
objection: Why pay every month when the kindergarten already teaches this and the free version plus YouTube is enough?
would_change_my_mind: If the kindergarten teacher used it and set homework through it, or other mothers in our Telegram group said their kids really learned to read with PRO.
